home.introText: House of Serene Wax is a professional, body-positive waxing studio in Decatur, GA. We specialize in Brazilian waxes, with expert technique, a gentle approach and a welcoming space to help you feel confident in your skin.
home.studioText: A calm, clean and private space. See what your visit looks like before you arrive.

about.heading: Waxing that feels like self-care.
about.story:
I've been in the waxing industry since 2021, and I created House of Serene Wax to offer professional, body-positive waxing for everyone.

Expert technique, a gentle approach and a welcoming atmosphere, so you leave feeling confident, smooth and comfortable in your skin.

promises.title: Brazilian specialists
promises.text: Expert technique focused on smooth, longer-lasting results.

promises.title: Body-positive
promises.text: A judgment-free studio where every body is welcome.

promises.title: Gentle approach
promises.text: Kenn explains each step so first-timers feel at ease.

promises.title: Private and calm
promises.text: One client at a time, in a clean and quiet space.

policies.title: Cancellations & no-shows
policies.text: Cancellations made less than 8 hours before your appointment, and missed appointments without notice, are subject to a 30% fee.
policies.homeText: Late cancellations and no-shows carry a 30% fee.

policies.title: Arriving for your appointment
policies.text: Early arrivals aren't permitted. There's a 10-minute grace period; after that, a $10 late fee applies.
policies.homeText: Please don't arrive early. After 10 minutes, a $10 late fee applies.

policies.title: Guests
policies.text: To keep the studio private and comfortable, guests can't join appointments.
policies.homeText: Appointments are just you, for a private, comfortable space.

policies.title: Payment
policies.text: Cash and all major credit and debit cards, due at the time of service.
